svg.text: Grove edge tokens — contrast measured on the surface each is actually drawn on
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 does NOT reach these borders. Understanding 1.4.11: "a border or other indication of the
overall boundary of the hit area is not required, as is therefore not subject to non-text contrast requirements."
The floor below is a PEER benchmark, not a legal one:
Primer borderColor-default 1.45:1 · Material 3 outline-variant 1.70:1 · Grove --border BEFORE: 1.09:1
LIGHT — before / after, each solved at its WORST rung
DARK — before / after, each solved at its WORST rung
Terminal ANSI palette — constrain the RANGE, do not pick sixteen colours
fancy-ansi emits var(--ansi-*) in its shipped dist, so the palette is reachable from CSS alone. Its defaults miss 4.5:1 on 13/16 colours in light and 5/16 in dark.
All 32 ANSI values clear 4.5:1 on every rung in both themes. Band 2.1x light / 2.9x dark, against the defaults' 8.7x / 10.9x.
